mapper.select: SELECT rc.rc_id, rc.register_id, rc.check_id, c.check_name, c.price FROM registercheck rc JOIN checkitem c ON rc.check_id = c.check_id WHERE rc.register_id = #{registerId} ORDER BY rc.rc_id
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(c.price), 0) FROM registercheck rc JOIN checkitem c ON rc.check_id = c.check_id WHERE rc.register_id = #{registerId}
